result.instructions: Tools for SolarPlus, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Show the SolarPlus contact 19670 with its status and address."; "Create a lead for John Doe at 222 Exhibition St, Melbourne VIC 3000 with the email john@example.com."; "Which custom contact fields does our SolarPlus account use?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes SolarPlus data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run solarplus_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run solarplus_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run solarplus_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. solarplus_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: solarplus_get_contact
tools.title: Get a contact
tools.description: Get one contact by id: name, email, phone, full address, status, source, business name, categories and notes. SolarPlus API: GET /api/contact/{id}.

contact_id.description: The contact id (from solarplus_create_contact or the SolarPlus app).

tools.name: solarplus_list_contact_fields
tools.title: List contact fields
tools.description: List the built-in contact fields with name, label, type, required flag and select options. Use it before creating or updating contacts. SolarPlus API: GET /api/contact/fields.

tools.name: solarplus_list_custom_contact_fields
tools.title: List custom contact fields
tools.description: List the custom contact fields this company set up, with the name to use in custom_fields. SolarPlus API: GET /api/contact/custom-fields.

tools.name: solarplus_create_contact
tools.title: Create a contact
tools.description: Create a contact (a lead by default). Required: first name, last name, email and full address. Creates a new record in the SolarPlus CRM. SolarPlus API: POST /api/contact.

full_address.description: Full address of the contact and site, for example '222 Exhibition St, Melbourne VIC 3000, Australia'.

business_as_client.description: true = quotes show the business name as the client name.

source.description: Lead source: 0 Other, 1 TV, 2 Radio, 3 Press, 4 Google, 5 Tradeshow, 6 Friends, 7 Website, 8 Word of Mouth, 9 Solar Quotes.

custom_fields.description: Custom fields as { field_name: value }. List the names with solarplus_list_custom_contact_fields.

tools.name: solarplus_update_contact
tools.title: Update a contact
tools.description: Change the given fields of one contact. Fields you leave out keep their current value. SolarPlus API: POST /api/contact/{id}.

contact_id.description: The contact id (from solarplus_create_contact or the SolarPlus app).

full_address.description: Full address of the contact and site.

business_as_client.description: true = quotes show the business name as the client name.

source.description: Lead source: 0 Other, 1 TV, 2 Radio, 3 Press, 4 Google, 5 Tradeshow, 6 Friends, 7 Website, 8 Word of Mouth, 9 Solar Quotes.

custom_fields.description: Custom fields as { field_name: value }. List the names with solarplus_list_custom_contact_fields.
